presentation.label: SAMPLE RATE
presentation.summary: FIN's knob becomes RATE, sound by sound: pure sample speed down to a stop and into reverse, like the Octatrack's RATE on PTCH.
presentation.overview: Sample RATE gives a sample a pure speed control: no time stretch, just the sample played faster or slower, down to a stop and on into reverse. Switch it on for a sound in SOUND SETTINGS with FIN AS RATE, and FIN's knob on the SAMPLE page reads RATE, 0 to 127: 127 plays at normal speed, 64 stops, 0 plays backward at normal speed, in a straight line between them, as the Octatrack's RATE with its setting on PTCH. Stock's pitch stops at a quarter of the speed. A trig below 64 starts from END. The setting saves with the sound and is off by default, so a sound plays stock until you ask.
highlights: Slow a sample to a dead stop and run it backward from one knob.
Exactly the Octatrack's range: 127 is 1x, 64 stops, 0 is -1x.
Per sound, saved with it, off by default: every other sound stays stock.
Takes parameter locks: one trig backward from END, the next forward.
Works beside LOP PIPO from Pipo Loop, without needing it.
usage: Put a long sample on a track, with LOP ON. Press FUNC + MUTE, choose SOUND SETTINGS, and set FIN AS RATE to ON.
Press SMPL and play the pad. Turn RATE down from 127: the sample slows like a stopping turntable and rests at 64.
Keep turning below 64: it runs backward, smoothly through the stop. A new trig now starts from END.
Hold a trig in GRID RECORDING and turn RATE to lock it on that step: a trig at 1 plays backward from END, and the next trig plays forward again.

access.location: SOUND SETTINGS: FIN AS RATE, the last row. Then the SAMPLE page: FIN's knob (encoder B) reads RATE.
steps: Select a track whose sound plays a sample.
Press FUNC + MUTE, choose SOUND SETTINGS, and go to the last row, FIN AS RATE.
Press RIGHT: the row reads ON.
Press NO until the menu closes, then SMPL: encoder B reads RATE.

controls.name: FIN AS RATE
controls.doc: SOUND SETTINGS, the last row. OFF: stock. ON: FIN is RATE on this sound. Saved with the sound. Switching on takes FIN +0 to RATE 127; switching off takes RATE 127 to FIN +0; other values stay.

controls.name: RATE
controls.doc: SAMPLE page, encoder B, on a sound with FIN AS RATE on. 0 to 127: speed scales by |RATE - 64| / 64, backward below 64, and 127 is exactly 1x. TUN still multiplies it. Locks and LFOs reach it as FIN.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only, with core-ar2 0.7.
Not tested on a unit yet; rytm-emu only (TESTING.md).
RATE never goes above 1x by itself; TUN does, to stock's ceiling of about 4x.
On stock OS a saved sound plays FIN as FIN: RATE 127 is about a semitone sharp.
With LOP OFF, once the sample has played out, changing RATE does not bring it back: trig again.
A change of direction on a looping voice waits until it is 32 frames clear of STA and END; a trig does not wait.
LFO destination lists and other screens still say FIN.
Sound locks, scene locks and performance locks have not been run.

claims: ui:SOUND SETTINGS row FIN AS RATE, after LEGACY FX SEND
param:FIN (id 40) label and value text while FIN AS RATE is on

load.display: About 0.2 % of a block with the row off, 0.35 % with eight voices in RATE (static estimate)
load.conditions: Static estimate from the compiled code: the block handler and the two gates in the step loop run for all eight voices every block, about 28 instructions a voice with the row off and about 60 with it on; at the Rytm guide's 0.023 % of a block per instruction a frame, about 0.2 % and 0.35 %. A change of direction adds one call of stock's frame routine a block while it waits. Not measured on a unit.

tests.summary: rytm-emu on OS 1.74, 23,777-frame ramp: rate word exact at every RATE tried, trig below 64 starts from END, row off sample-identical to the core alone, with Pipo Loop no clicks at 1x, slow, below one frame a block, in reverse, or across flips. No unit yet.
